lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I've been looking everywhere for you! I told you to stay put and rest. Where on earth have you been wandering?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry. What did you call me for?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: There's something I need you to do. And I refuse to accept a refusal. ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh... I suppose I have no choice. I'll gladly help.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You really are entertaining.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But something feels off about the city. Has something happened?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You noticed quickly. They've started moving.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They... meaning?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It seems soldiers from the Dark Holy Kingdom of Deimos have entered the area.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's why I want you to go to Kali and warn them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Kali?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yes, Kali. The village of the Kali people, one of Eastland's minority groups.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: They are a people strongly attuned to nature, blessed by the sky and the earth. Long ago, the Deimos cult hunted them for a certain reason.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So they abandoned their homeland and searched for a place to settle, eventually reaching a corner of Adrica, the Land of Illusions.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Old Atkina helped them settle there, and they've lived there ever since. I have a feeling those soldiers are after the Kali people.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Though that's a little unexpected.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What is?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't expect you to be concerned about other people, Lady Shynic...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Everyone on this continent hates the Deimos cult. So if you make any silly jokes, I'll kill you. ♡ Understood?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Y-yes. Please don't kill me. Anyway, I just need to go and warn them, right?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yes. Medea, one of the Champions you want to meet, is in Kali too. Tell her I sent you. All right?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh, right. There's something you should do first. I sent an illusion of myself to Adrica, just in case.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that illusion that makes you want to punch it?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You just said what you really think, didn't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: N-no. Nothing at all.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Whatever. My illusion told me someone is wandering around Adrica. Go see them on your way. Tell them they'll be safe in Tartaros.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: With the mythical beasts gone, people who start wandering the Land of Illusions sometimes never find their way out before they die. Understand? Make sure you tell them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Which way is Kali?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Leave Tartaros to the west, and you'll see Adrica, the Land of Illusions. Just keep going that way.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Ordinarily, only certain special people can find Kali. But you're the goddess's errand-runner, so you should find it easily.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll be on my way.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Good. I'll be guarding this place, so see you later. And about that person... Huh, gone already...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: No helping it. I'll leave meeting that person up to our little friend...

steps.name: A Lost Girl
steps.objective: Defeat [Hungry Graduals] and [Dies] in "Adrica", then report to [Minuet].

lines.text: (A girl is wandering around with a vacant expression. She seems to be the lost traveler Shynic mentioned.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me. Hello?
... (Stares blankly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me!
Y-yes?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't be startled! I'm not anyone suspicious.
I've never met anyone who said they weren't suspicious who wasn't suspicious, but...
I'll trust you! I'll give it a try.
My name is Minuet. Nice to meet you!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (%s introduces themself as well.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, that's enough introductions... Minuet, I'll show you the way. You should go to a place called Tartaros.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Y-yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First, I'll clear the area a little and open a path for you. Just wait a moment.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: You... have a special power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A special power? You can sense something like that in me?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I'm not really sure. I just felt it.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Come to think of it, why did I feel that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm... That's a little bewildering.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She's an interesting person.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm in a hurry, so I'd better go. Keep heading east to reach Tartaros. Travel safely, all right?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes. Thank you.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: (As %s turns to leave, they notice the wounds on Minuet's arms and legs.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um... Minuet?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You've got some serious wounds on your arms and legs. Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: They sting, but they don't hurt too badly. This body seems to be very sturdy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This body?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: This body...? Huh. Why did I say that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could you tell me how you came here?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Well... I can't remember...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I thought very hard about how to answer you... but I have no idea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you lost, by any chance?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I don't even know that. At least I'm not so foolish that I've forgotten my own name.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...You're remarkably cheerful, considering the circumstances.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Thank you. No one's ever said that to me before!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The more I look at Minuet, the more worried I get...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet, I'm really sorry. I'd like to take you to Tartaros myself, but I'm far too busy right now. I don't think I can spare the time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Keep going east, and you'll see the entrance to Tartaros. I cleared the way fairly well on my way here, so it shouldn't be too dangerous, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you feel you're in danger, come back here. All right?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes, I will. Thank you. Please don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then take care.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Stop right there. What brings an outsider here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Is he wary of me?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came to warn you that soldiers from the Dark Holy Kingdom of Deimos seem to have appeared nearby...

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Understood. Consider your message delivered. Now leave.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? That's incredibly rude! What if I refuse to just leave?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Then you'll pay for trespassing in this village.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: You... wait a moment.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: A goddess's blessing—not one, but two... three? What on earth are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Three? Not just one, but two or three? Iris's blessing is obvious... Could one be Lady Seres's? But what's the other?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you know that, anyway?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: I hate to admit it, but I can sense such things...

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: More to the point, are you the errand-runner for that goddess from the western continent...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I do some work for the goddess. They sent me from Tartaros to warn you about the danger.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Tartaros? Shynic sent you. If you came straight to our village rather than Dragon Valley, the situation must be dangerous indeed...

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: All right. Merimel knows where Lady Medea is. Go see her.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: She's in the center of the village, so you'll find her easily. There'll be all sorts of junk around her, but don't worry about that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're kinder than I expected. You could have said that from the beginning...

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: I'm only like that with outsiders. A-and thank you for the compliment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What a strange fellow. Well, let's find this Merimel...)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: ...I put all this work into making things, but no one in this village uses them. Without Noel, there's no one to appreciate their true worth. Sigh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's this? It looks really well made. You seem just as skilled with your hands as the person at the village entrance said.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: It's a machine that feeds birds automatically. Hehe, I'm handier than I look. But who are you? An outsider? An outsider? An outsider?!

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Aaaaah! An outsider! An outsider!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What kind of reaction is that? Is she happy or upset?)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Oh, pull yourself together! Even if I hardly ever see outsiders, this is rude.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: What brings you here, out-si-der?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Shynic of Tartaros told me to visit someone named Medea. Where can I find her?

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Is there any reason I should tell an outsider that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not necessarily, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Would you like something from outside the village? If you don't, there's nothing I can do...

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Something from outside?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You search your pocket and hand Merimel a piece of jerky from Lumen.)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Oh! Is this...? This is...!

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: I think I've heard of it! There's supposed to be some delicious jerky in the outside world!

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: How can anything taste this good...? (Amazed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-wait. That isn't meant for you to eat... Too late, I suppose.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: (Merimel doesn't seem to hear you.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh... All right. I'll give you a few more pieces.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Ahem. Ahem. Since you've shown your sincerity, I'll tell you where Lady Medea is.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: She should be in front of the enormous tree at the far end of the village. Though she may be uncomfortable with an outsider appearing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that because of the Deimos cult?

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Yes. The cult hunts our people. They say we have a special power... I don't know what they do with it, but many of us have fallen victim to them...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So the Deimos cult is the reason you live cut off from the outside world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But is there a reason you dislike outsiders like me? Everyone seems so hostile...

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: You don't know much about us, do you? We look different from ordinary humans. That alone has made life difficult for us for a long time.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: We're human too. But outsiders won't acknowledge it.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Not everyone is like that, I'm sure. But many people simply won't accept what's different.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: We only look a little different, yet some people refuse to see us as human. We've always struggled with that, even when the Deimos cult wasn't involved...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can see how that would happen. I'm sorry. I didn't think it through.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: It's all right. Thank you for understanding, even now...

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: That may be why Lady Medea is so determined to keep our people from going outside.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Come to think of it, you said you came from Tartaros, didn't you? Noel... Oh, never mind. Please go see Lady Medea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Next time, I'll remember to bring you something from outside.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: I-in that case, I'd prefer j-jerky! And when you have time, could you come see me again?

steps.name: A Girl Without Memories
steps.objective: Defeat [Flag-Bearing Agnus] and [Sleepy Tremendes] in "Adrica", then report to [Minuet].

lines.text: (A faint but potent power emanates from a woman carrying an unusual staff. Her gaze makes her discomfort plain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello...? Are you Lady Medea?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes. I am Medea of the Kali people. It has been a long time since an outsider came this far to see me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then this should be quick to explain. The reason I'm here is...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The worsening state of the Land of Illusions tells me that soldiers of the Deimos cult have arrived.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: As we always have, we will remain quiet and hidden, waiting for them to leave.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Go back, outsider. I do not trust you.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: However much favor the goddess shows you, there is nothing I can do for you. Even if I gave you my power, I don't know whether it would help her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I haven't explained everything yet. How much do you know?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I can sense Shynic's presence within you. The power of one who lives only because an ominous curse prevents her from dying...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Of course, I know Shynic sent you out of concern for me. But I cannot simply accept an outsider's intentions. I hope you understand.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Wait. You... Isn't there something more important for you to do than visit me right now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Could today be...? Ah, did you happen to see anyone wandering around Adrica, the Land of Illusions?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. There was a girl who had lost her way. I gave her directions to Tartaros.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That lady... I mean, that person may not be able to leave the Land of Illusions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean by that?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: As the Deimos soldiers hunted the mythical beasts, the land lost its ability to regulate itself.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The mythical beasts and illusion plants began to see outsiders as threats to the land and its life, and absorbed the power of anyone they identified that way.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That power included their memories. The land stripped away their recollections so they would wander here forever, until they died.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Those outsiders return to the earth and become nourishment for the mythical beasts and illusion plants.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Th-that's dangerous! But how was I able to pass through? Surely the same thing should have happened to me...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You serve a goddess, so you were able to escape it... This is no time to linger. Go at once and check on that lady.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If her condition hasn't changed, go to Dragon Valley and ask Lord Atkina for help. He must be facing difficulties of his own right now, but...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: On your way, deal with the beings disturbing the Land of Illusions. You must hurry...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I'll go right away.

steps.name: A Shadow over the Valley
steps.objective: Defeat the [Mythical Beast Kyrie] in the "Dragon Valley", then find [Atkina] in the deepest part of the "Dragon Valley".

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet! Minuet!

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Oh, I'm over here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine. You saved me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad nothing happened to you...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I came back here, just as you said. No... I ended up back here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...What do you mean? You ended up back here?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I walked toward the town to try to leave this place, but every time I did, I lost consciousness.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: When I came to, I was always here...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: As if I'm not allowed to leave this place...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really? Then I'll take you with me and hold on to you!

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: (No matter which path you take while holding on to Minuet, you return to the place where she was standing.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this phenomenon...?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: See? That's why it's so frustrating.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is there some kind of curse? This is maddening.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Someone named Medea told me to go to Dragon Valley if your situation hadn't changed...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: The lord of this land...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Minuet's expression seems to change slightly.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: At... kina...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine. I think I'm a little tired. I feel sleepy... but I'll try to stay awake. How strange.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd better go see him...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet, wait here. I'll find Atkina and work out a way to help you, somehow. Please wait for me. At least this spot seems safe...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes... thank you...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: (Apparently exhausted, Minuet leans against a boulder and falls asleep.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd better hurry. She'll be safe here, won't she?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This started as nothing more than Shynic asking me to warn the Kali people about danger...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could this be...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I'll save the idle thoughts for later. Time to go.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The darkness holding Kyrie has receded. When was the last time Dragon Valley was so filled with darkness...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a pleasure to meet you, Lord Atkina. I am...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly introduce yourself to Atkina.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I heard a follower of Goddess Iris had come to this continent. So that was you. Thanks to you, the darkness in Dragon Valley has vanished.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I expected you would come here someday. Though I had hoped we would meet under different circumstances...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: How shameful. The lord of this domain, trapped in his own lands by mythical beasts tainted with darkness...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The Deimos soldiers had been quiet, but now they've come here again to hunt the mythical beasts and the Kali people.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: They're using the power of the beasts and the Kali for something. It's frustrating that we still haven't discovered exactly what.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Come to think of it, I haven't heard why you sought me out. What is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Atkina about gathering the Champions' power, and about Minuet, the girl wandering lost in Adrica.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Wait. That lady is in the Land of Illusions? And she has lost her memory...? Adrica is in danger.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know Minuet?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I do. Please go to her in my place and awaken her memories. If you don't, there's no telling what might happen...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Adrica is in danger. You must restore her memories at once.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who exactly is Minuet, for you to react like this? And what am I supposed to do?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It will be quicker to meet her yourself. And introduce the one you follow to me. That will be the quickest way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris's power is still lacking. It may be difficult for her to speak with you.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: (Atkina raises a hand toward the sky. A moment later, a clear, pure breeze arrives from somewhere, passes through his hand, and brushes %s's face.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: This is power that both Iris and that lady need. To put it simply, call it a 'Memory Fragment.' I've also passed a portion of my own power to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Lord Atkina.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I will greet Iris separately. You should hurry to that lady.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Y-yes... Do I just go to her?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The Memory Fragments held by the mythical beasts have already merged into your fingertips. Take her hand.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: You have my word, as one who followed the mistress of the moon, flowers, and growing things.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm sure I've met her sometime before. Why can't I remember clearly...?)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I will begin purifying the Land of Illusions, so help her first. Oh, and...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Once everything here is resolved, would you come see me? It's nothing urgent. I'd like to speak to you about your memories.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, understood. I'll go right away.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: (When %s disappears from view on the way out of Dragon Valley, Iris's faint image appears before Atkina.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hello, Atkina...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It is a pleasure to meet you, Goddess Iris. You look just like Lady Seres and that child.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: By that child, you mean...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The one Lady Seres cherished and called 'Tyr'... Your distant ancestor...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you, Atkina. For remembering her... I have much to discuss with you, but could you wait a little longer?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The darkness has not yet left the Land of Illusions. And the sinner, too...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The sinner... Is it the person I suspect?

steps.name: The Goddess's Dwelling
steps.objective: Defeat [Requiem] in the "Divine Tree Lapier" and obtain the <Crystal of a Fading World>. Then report to [Minuet] in "Adrica".

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: %s... you're back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine. This place is gradually becoming clearer. I think it's making me feel better.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a relief. Would you take my hand for a moment?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Huh? Your hand?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Atkina told me how to restore your memories. He said I should hold your hand...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Believe it or not, let's give it a try.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: (Minuet nods and takes %s's hand. A moment later, a clear, pure breeze blows in from somewhere and brushes their joined hands.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What a pleasant breeze... Huh? Minuet?!)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A sharp gust follows, forcing you to let go of Minuet's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet, are you all right?!

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I'm all right, %s... Thanks to you, my memories have returned.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a relief. Then let me guide you to the nearest town.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I don't think that will be necessary. And allow me to introduce myself again. I am...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: (A mysterious light, unlike anything seen in Adrica, the Land of Illusions, begins to spread before Minuet.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this light...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It feels as though the light could blind you. You quickly raise an arm to shield your eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is like...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: %s... look at me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Minuet's voice seems subtly different. You lift your head and see a being who resembles her, yet is altogether different.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Who are you?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Thank you. You helped me recover my memories. My name is Gaia... I helped shape this land for my younger sister Seres, who loved this world...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: (Suddenly, you become acutely aware of Gaia's presence. Her name seems to have been etched into your mind along with the light.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gaia, Goddess of the Earth... Lady Gaia?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry. I didn't want us to meet this way... Long ago, I exhausted all my power protecting the continent. Since then, I have alternated between sleep and wakefulness.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Unable to spend much power, I would roam briefly in human form. Minuet is my present human incarnation.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: When I woke this time and was looking around the Land of Illusions, I encountered a profound, wicked darkness. I was on my way to consult Atkina when...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: You may call me a weak god. This was all my own failure...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If even a god in human form could lose her memory, the danger must be immense.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry. Some of my memories have returned, but my power has not fully recovered...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don't need to apologize.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: While I wandered without my memories, a wielder of darkness overran my sanctuary in the Land of Illusions, and Atkina became trapped as well.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm all right, Lady Gaia. What should I do, then?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Would you check inside my sanctuary, Lapier? In my present condition, I can't tell what is happening there...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I'll go.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Please be careful...
(Deep inside the divine tree Lapier, a man stands beside an ominous being. For a moment, your eyes meet.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A being with sinister power has entered this sacred place, the goddess's sanctuary...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He must be an enemy. Anyone who could intrude this far can't be an ordinary human...)
What a nuisance.
Get rid of them...
(As soon as the suspicious man finishes speaking, the ominous being beside him steps forward.)
You who aid a god—embrace your fate. Requiem, a funeral song worthy of death, shall guide you...
Interesting. To think Requiem would meet such an end...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Huff... huff... whew. That was rough. I thought I was going to die...)
A pity, but I'll postpone your death until next time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where do you think you're going?! What are you plotting here?!
(You rush toward the suspicious man, but a strange barrier prevents you from reaching him. Instead, an unfamiliar force closes in and begins constricting your entire body.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: U-urgh... Aaaaaah!
Interesting. You help a god without asking anything in return... You must believe this world can continue as it is.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what are you talking about? Aaaah! Gaaaah...
(Every flick of the suspicious man's finger sends excruciating pain through your body.)
Go and tell the god you believe in: the world that weak god loved will soon disappear. Through the power of this 'binding'...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This power is a 'binding'?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaaaaaah!
That should be enough of a scare...
(When the suspicious man stops moving his hand, the pain tormenting your body vanishes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hah... hah... Urgh... Ugh...
For enduring that pain, I'll give you my name. I am Weiss. The being so cursed by the creatures of this land...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: And one who has no choice but to sin...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: (Weiss stares at %s, collapsed and writhing in pain. Then he smiles faintly.)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Then I shall await our next meeting. Assuming you're still alive in this world by then...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: (Weiss is no longer in sight.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does he mean? The world will disappear...? I have to warn them... U-urgh... First, Lady Gaia.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Welcome back...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: (Minuet slowly takes Gaia's form. The girl who wandered Adrica without her memories is nowhere to be seen.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Thanks to you, the darkness in Lapier has receded. I no longer sense darkness in Adrica, either.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Thank you. I believe I can enter Lapier again now. But %s, you don't look well. Would you tell me what's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Gaia what happened inside the divine tree Lapier.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Wait. Weiss...?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Weiss was there?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: So he was the one who brought all that wicked darkness here.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: And this object comes from another world...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: From another world...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A strange feeling suddenly envelops your entire body.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This feeling... from when I met Weiss... Yes, fear. It's fear. I've hardly ever felt afraid before... Why now...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: L-Lady Gaia... Who is Weiss? Why is he doing this?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Poor %s. All of this is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: (Suddenly, you can no longer hear Gaia's voice. Your vision soon blurs, until you cannot even see her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what is this...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's dark... Where am I? I can't see anything...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: You summoned us here... So it was you after all...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is someone here, Lady Gaia...?
It's been a long time. Your name was Gaia, I believe...
(An old man's low voice sounds from somewhere. Every word carries tremendous pressure.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Urgh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Your legs give way, leaving you unable to stand. You look up and see Gaia's face drawn tight.)

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: As I thought, Gaia does not welcome me. But that is quite all right.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: This world, abandoned even by the gods when that absurd power of chaos and darkness swept over it...

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: I was certain its destruction was near. Impressive that it still holds on. I once sent this world a gift, you know.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Do you remember the bird that destroyed itself? The slave created to be subject to darkness, without any choice in the matter.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That was...)

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: It extinguished its flames for a single human... That human who follows the new god should know the story, too.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Ah, perhaps you were asleep and didn't know... But it did happen. Well, enough of that story.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: There's something I want to ask. What about you?

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Are humans and this world worth exhausting every last bit of your power?

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Look for yourself. Since you fell asleep, has the world unfolded as you wished...?

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: How laughable: a weak god unable to deal with even the Demon King, doing nothing while waiting for a savior.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: I know you won't answer me. I never expected you to.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Even without the Demon King, your world will perish someday. There are those who wish it so. Don't forget that I am one of them.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: I have already sent something to destroy you, the lives you cherish, and this world you love.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: A gift I selected with considerable care.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Stop it. Stop!

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: However much you tell me to stop, I cannot. You know our roles have made this inevitable from the very beginning, don't you?

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: I meant to summon only you, but somehow that human came along as well.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: The girl who succeeded Seres, rising from human to god, brought a human into attunement with herself. And...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Don't touch them! Harm so much as a hair, and I won't let you get away with it! Besides, frightening people is all you can do!

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: How ridiculous, Gaia. What could you do, powerless and forever sleeping?!

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Then I shall leave things here for today.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: As will I...

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: If you meet Seres someday, give her my regards. Tell her the world she loved so much vanished without a trace. Hahahahaha...

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: (The old man's voice disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This world will disappear...? That's absurd...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The primal power relentlessly pressing down on your head and shoulders dims the consciousness you've barely managed to hold on to.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry, Seres...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry, Iris. I'm sorry, %s...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: (Gaia's voice grows fainter until you can no longer hear it.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: (Minuet's worried face comes into view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where am I...?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'm all right.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: That's a relief.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: (The girl who was Minuet takes Gaia's form.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry... Those are the only words a weak god can offer...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That old man... I once saw the Memorial of someone he'd sent. I heard that voice there. I never thought I'd hear it like this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who on earth is he?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry. I can't tell you anything right now. You'll learn when the time comes, but...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Can you understand that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. Everyone has things they can't speak about. I understand. Even if that someone is a god...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Thank you, %s... The darkness has receded, and Atkina has finished the purification ritual. You may return now.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Once you leave here, you won't be able to see me for a while. Using my power could send me back to sleep again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will we be able to meet again?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I can't give you a definite answer. But I can promise one thing.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Whenever you come here, I will leave Minuet waiting so you can speak with her.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Minuet is my incarnation. Though only a part of me, she remains connected to me. From now on, only you will be able to see her. Come and speak to her whenever you need to.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: %s, go to Medea and Shynic and tell them about me. They will naturally understand what happened.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Thank you for everything. We will meet again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Lady Gaia has gone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Minuet...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: If you ever need to ask Lady Gaia for something, or want to speak with her, come see me here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. But should I think of you as a separate person from the goddess, Minuet?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Hmm... You could say we're the same, or that we're different.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I understand. Lady... Gaia?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: You may call me Minuet while I'm in this form.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Minuet. But is it okay for me to leave without introducing Iris to Lady Gaia?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: They may already be meeting privately in some way we don't know about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I suppose you're right. Then I'll see you next time, Minuet...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes. Until next time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're still looking at me as though I make you uncomfortable.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm sorry if I gave that impression. The Land of Illusions has regained its vitality, and the goddess has returned. The remaining Deimos cultists have vanished, too...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you know...?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Lady Gaia did not come in person, but she told me what happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, so that's what she meant...)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: What will you do now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hm? Oh, I suppose I'll keep doing what I've done so far.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There's something I'd like to ask, if it wouldn't be too rude.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. What is it?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Do you believe the work you do for your god—the path you follow—is right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've never really considered anything else along the way. I came this far thinking only of finding Iris. Of course, there were difficult times.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: So you came all this way for Iris alone.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I see. That was a good answer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel as though you have more questions... Was that everything?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes. Your answer was enough. I understand what kind of person you are now.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I can't say for certain, but I think I can trust you a little. Until that trust is complete... please visit us often.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Perhaps... when that time comes, we may have a different conversation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a good sign, then. I'll try to earn your trust...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: And one more thing...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Everything has light and shadow. Light is not always good, just as darkness is not always evil. The same applies to your power and to what you do. Please remember that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. Light and shadow...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I'll keep that in mind.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If you're heading back, please give Shynic my regards.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Well done, %s! You kept me thoroughly entertained! Ahahahaha!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see you've found out what happened without my telling you again.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's right. Thanks to her influence, I know a fair amount.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But didn't you already expect what would happen before I left?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I knew half of it. The other half, I didn't.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Which half did you know, and which didn't you?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's a secret. Anyway, how did it feel to meet her? I meant to introduce you myself, originally...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I suppose it means there's one more god among my acquaintances?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What a boring answer. And there was someone else you met.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (His face flashes through your mind, making you tremble. Your first true moment of terror since coming to Eastland...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You mean Weiss...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What was he like?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You're frightened. Anyone who's experienced his power would be. He's almost as close to absolute evil as Deimos, the Twisted One, god of fear and war...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You'll be seeing Weiss more often now. If he's made his move, something big may happen soon.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Did I scare you more than I meant to? Ahahaha. Things won't be easy from now on. Neither you nor the god you serve can afford to back down. Understood?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine. If I rest... a little rest should help. Just a little rest...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: All right. Don't overdo it... But you won't be able to rest for long.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes... I'll be going, then.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: (Shynic watches %s intently as they trudge back to their lodgings.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Well, perhaps things will stay quiet for a little while now. But the gods still aren't doing their part... Ugh. How dull.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Melvic.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Yes, Lady Shynic?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Tell that beast in the hat. That man is a 'real one,' just like you lot...
